title: donor
description: One resolved donor: an individual behind many contributor-name, employer and address variants, across every cycle. One file, `donor.parquet`, beside the crosswalk.

donor_id.description: The donor's id. Stable from snapshot to snapshot, except where a donor is merged or split.

display_name.description: The name the donor's contributions report with the most money. Each display column is chosen alone, so the name may come from one spelling and the employer from another.

employer.description: The employer the donor's contributions report with the most money.

occupation.description: The occupation the donor's contributions report with the most money.

city.description: The city the donor's contributions report with the most money.

state.description: The state the donor's contributions report with the most money.

zip5.description: The five-digit ZIP code the donor's contributions report with the most money.

total_all_cycles.description: The donor's contributions in dollars in every cycle, refunds netted.

first_cycle.description: The first cycle the donor appears in.

last_cycle.description: The last cycle the donor appears in.

contributor_key_count.description: The number of contributor keys resolved to the donor.
